curtain.notes: Origin is the centre of the top edge; hangs 3.4 m. One skin, drawn double sided. Tile several side by side for a wider drape.

stage_light.notes: Origin is the top of the clamp, which hooks a 48 mm bar. The can points forward and 35 degrees down. Lens is lamp_glow.

speaker.notes: PA speaker on a tripod. The legs reach 0.45 m from the pole, so the feet span 0.9 m. Keep it off the walls.

costume_rack.notes: Four headless suits on a rolling rail, 1.8 m long; the sleeves reach about 0.05 m past each end. The third from the left hangs full and has its feet on the floor; the others are empty. Put it side on to a doorway so the row is seen from across the room.

spare_heads.notes: Six heads on steel shelving and a seventh on top, tipped forward to look down at the room, all facing the front (-Y in Blender, +Z in three.js). Stand it against a wall facing a door.

mannequin.notes: Dress form on a castor stand, 2.0 m to the top of the spare bear head someone jammed on it askew, with a fur suit half pinned on and one empty sleeve. Reads as a person in the dark.

vanity.notes: Make-up table with a bulb mirror. Ten bulbs in lamp_glow, three more dead or missing. A foam wig head stands on the top.

trunk.notes: Wardrobe trunk, lid ajar, fur and one sleeve spilling over the front. The lid does not move.

arcade_cabinet.notes: Upright cabinet. Screen is screen_glow, marquee is sign_glow; both take their picture from the art atlas, so tint the emissive rather than replacing the map.

claw_machine.notes: Glass on four sides (material glass, alpha blended). The strip under the roof of the glass box is lamp_glow. The claw has a toy by the head.

skee_ball.notes: Lane runs back from the player along +Y in Blender (-Z in three.js); the origin is the centre of the 0.8 x 2.8 cabinet. Tickets and a stray ball lie on the floor up to 0.35 m in front of it. Wants a wall behind it.

prize_counter.notes: Glass fronted and glass topped (material glass). The staff side is +Y in Blender.

stool.notes: Bolted to the floor on a flange; 0.62 m to the seat.

table_round.notes: Round table, 1.3 m across the top, laid for a party that was not cleared away. The cloth flares to 1.5 m and hangs to about 0.45 m off the floor.

chair_fallen.notes: The same chair on its left side, turned a little. Origin is still the centre of its footprint.

table_long.notes: Folding trestle table, bare. 0.75 m high.

balloons.notes: A bunch on strings from a floor weight, drooping to head height and below, with dead ones on the floor. The yellow one has a printed face and hangs at about 1.6 m.

banner.notes: Pennants on a string between two points 4 m apart; origin is midway between them. Sags 0.45 m. One flag is gone and two hang by a corner, so it reads HAPPY BIR HDAY.

standee.notes: Plywood photo board, cut to the outline of the two mascots, with two face holes at 1.47 and 1.33 m. It is 1.8 m wide and 0.02 m thick on feet 0.4 m deep; seen from behind it is bare ply.

high_chair.notes: Wooden high chair with a tray. Something was left in the bowl.

trash_can.notes: Overflowing swing-top bin; its lid is on the floor beside it and litter spreads about 0.5 m round it.

gift_pile.notes: Seven unopened presents, swollen with damp. One has split at a corner.

counter_steel.notes: Stainless prep counter with an upstand along the back (+Y in Blender) and a lower shelf.

fridge.notes: Two-door commercial fridge. The right door is the child node "door", hinged on its right edge (vertical axis). Its rest pose is already 14 degrees open: turn it -0.244 rad about Y in three.js to shut it, positive to open further. The left door is fixed. With the door at rest the front corner stands 0.15 m proud of the 0.8 m depth. The cabinet is dark inside, with something on the floor of it.

range.notes: Six-burner range with an oven and a stub of extraction hood on a riser at the back.

sink_unit.notes: Double bowl sink with two taps on the upstand. A rubber glove hangs over the edge of the left bowl.

pot_rack.notes: Hangs on four rods from the ceiling; origin is the centre of the top. Pots, pans and ladles hang to 0.9 m below it, so over a counter it clears heads; in open floor it does not.

wire_shelf.notes: Chrome wire shelving with tins, tubs and boxes. One tin has blown.

meat_rail.notes: Overhead rail with four sliding hooks; origin is the centre of the top. The second hook from the right holds a bundle in stained cloth, 1.1 m long, whose lowest point is 1.85 m below the origin: hang the rail so that clears the floor by a little. A stain on the floor under it would help.

snack_counter.notes: Serving counter, customers on the -Y side in Blender (+Z in three.js). 1.1 m to the top; the till and sneeze guard stand above that. The staff side is open shelving.

soda_machine.notes: Vending machine, 1.0 x 0.76 m. The whole lit front is sign_glow and takes its picture from the art atlas; parts of it are dead. A power lead trails 0.3 m out of the back and a dried puddle of syrup reaches 0.2 m out in front.

popcorn_cart.notes: Popcorn machine on a two-wheeled cart. Glass case (material glass) with the kettle inside; the heat lamp under the roof is lamp_glow. Handle is on the +X side in Blender.

bar_stool.notes: Four-legged bar stool, 0.76 m to the seat, with a low back rail.

menu_board.notes: Felt letter board. Origin is the centre of its back face; it stands 0.08 m off the wall. Letters are missing and a few lie in the bottom of the frame.
